Spear, the first and only two-time winner of The Nation's Top Physical Therapy Practice, offers 25+ convenient locations in the NYC metro area, specializing in various services to help you along your health journey. Let’s Keep Moving, New York!

Spear is here to relieve that pesky pain that’s keeping you down, to ensure you come back from that surgery better than ever, or to simply keep you healthy and active.

With 140+ of the nation’s top physical therapists, Spear offers you free, online education; remote and virtual assessments from any device; and 24 immaculate, sparkling-clean clinics in the NYC metro area.

Twice awarded the best physical therapy practice in the nation by two separate industry organizations, and being named to the Inc. 5000 list 6 times, you can trust that your body, health, and mind are in safe hands with Spear.
